sections.h2: Maharashtra gives 19.97% of matched GST but gets back 6.44% of devolution

chart.title: Devolution follows population and income, not where GST is collected
chart.sub: Share of matched GST and of devolution, %.

sections.means: Maharashtra's devolution share (6.44%) is well below its GST share (19.97%), while Uttar Pradesh's (17.62%) is about double its GST share (8.72%).
sections.todo: Check the full-year devolution figures against these instalment shares before treating the gap as settled.

sections.h2: National domestic GST fell 2.6% in FY2025-26, after growth every year before

chart.title: Domestic GST fell in 2025-26, the first year-on-year decline in this window

sections.means: Growth had already slowed each year, from 20.7% to 10.0%, before the 2025-26 reversal.
sections.todo: Compare later years against the 2025-26 level of ₹16.32 lakh crore before calling the dip a trend.

sections.h2: Uttar Pradesh's domestic GST fell 11.0% in 2025-26, the sharpest drop listed

chart.title: Only Uttar Pradesh fell below its FY2023-24 level among these ten states
chart.sub: Year-on-year change in domestic GST, FY2025-26, %.

sections.means: Uttar Pradesh is also the single largest devolution recipient, so it takes the biggest share of tax back while losing ground on its own GST base.
sections.todo: Check Uttar Pradesh's FY2026-27 GST collections to see whether the decline has continued.
